title: Memon Society Campus, Hyderabad | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Memon Society Campus, located in Hyderabad, Pakistan. Address: Memon Society, Phase 1, Qasimabad, Hyderabad, Sindh. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Hyderabad as the city.
